import json
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
from datetime import timedelta
from django.utils import timezone
from apps.catalog.models import Offer,OfferObservation,OfferCandidate,OfferFamilyPlacement
from apps.catalog.services.public_eligibility import public_eligibility_q,is_ship_from_verified
from apps.catalog.services.weekly_discovery import WEEKLY_FAMILY_SLUGS,PENDING_CAP_PER_FAMILY
now=timezone.now()
offers=list(Offer.objects.filter(public_eligibility_q()).distinct().only("id","ship_from_country","ship_from_verified_at"))
ids=[o.id for o in offers]
by_id={o.id:o for o in offers}
latest={}
price={}
numeric=set()
for ob in OfferObservation.objects.filter(offer_id__in=ids).order_by("offer_id","-observed_at","-id").only("offer_id","observed_at","availability","price","currency","delivery_days","search_delivery_days"):
    latest.setdefault(ob.offer_id,ob)
    if ob.price is not None and (ob.currency or "").strip(): price.setdefault(ob.offer_id,ob)
    if ob.delivery_days is not None or ob.search_delivery_days is not None: numeric.add(ob.offer_id)
fam=defaultdict(set)
for p in OfferFamilyPlacement.objects.filter(offer_id__in=ids).values("offer_id","product_family__slug"):fam[p["product_family__slug"]].add(p["offer_id"])
out=[]
for slug in WEEKLY_FAMILY_SLUGS:
    subs=fam[slug]
    valid=sum(is_ship_from_verified(by_id[i],as_of=now) for i in subs)
    pending=OfferCandidate.objects.filter(product_family__slug=slug,status="PENDING").count()
    out.append({"family":slug,"public_eligible":len(subs),"origin_verified":valid,"origin_unverified":len(subs)-valid,"stock_unknown":sum(i not in latest or latest[i].availability=="UNKNOWN" for i in subs),"numeric_delivery_ever":len(subs & numeric),"price_unconfirmed_24h":sum(i not in price or price[i].observed_at<now-timedelta(hours=24) for i in subs),"pending":pending,"discovery_paused":pending>=PENDING_CAP_PER_FAMILY})
print("REA_CATALOG_AUDIT="+json.dumps({"utc":now.isoformat(),"total_offers":Offer.objects.count(),"public_eligible":len(offers),"by_family":out,"stored_origin_countries":dict(Counter((o.ship_from_country or "MISSING") for o in offers)),"recent_last_observation_count":sum(i in latest and latest[i].observed_at>=now-timedelta(hours=24) for i in ids),"retired_pending":OfferCandidate.objects.filter(status="PENDING",product_family__status="RETIRED").count()},sort_keys=True))
